# SlateMate eRaksha

> eRaksha is an AI-powered child digital safety platform built by SlateMate Private Limited, an IIT Madras Incubation Cell (IITMIC) incubated, DPIIT-recognised startup headquartered at IIT Madras Research Park, Chennai, India.

## Key facts
- Product: eRaksha — DNS protection layer + AI child companion + parent dashboard
- Company: SLATEMATE PRIVATE LIMITED, founded 2023, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
- Official launch: 14 November 2026
- Pricing: Free plan (free forever) and Premium plan at ₹349 per month per child
- Privacy: no ads, no data selling; designed for India's DPDP Act 2023
- Audience: parents of children aged 10–16, schools and NGOs in India
- Contact: info@slatemate.in, +91 90258 67204 (WhatsApp available)
- Registration: CIN U62090TN2026PTC191373 · DPIIT Recognised Startup DIPP261360
- Platform: Android 10+ (iOS and web planned)

## Founders
- Ayush Ranjan — Founder & CEO (IIT Madras Nirmaan fellow)
- Prabhat Ranjan — CTO
- Drushti Surkar — CPO

## Original research
- [eRaksha Parent Survey 2025](https://www.slatemate.in/research/parent-survey-2025): 84% of Indian parents feel helpless managing their child's digital life
